definitions.explanation: A weapon that derives its destructive force from nuclear fission reactions.

examples.japanese: {原子爆弾|げんしばくだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{投下|とうか}→投下：12893_touka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{原子爆弾|げんしばくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{甚大|じんだい}→甚大：17386_jindai⟧だった。
examples.english: The damage from the atomic bomb was enormous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広島|ひろしま}→広島：28985_hiroshima⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{長崎|ながさき}→長崎：30731_nagasaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{原子爆弾|げんしばくだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}とされた→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1945⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
examples.english: It was in 1945 that atomic bombs were dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

notes:
Usually abbreviated to ⟦{原爆|げんばく}→原爆：11942_genbaku⟧ in everyday usage. The full form {原子爆弾|げんしばくだん} tends to appear in formal or historical contexts. As the only country to have experienced nuclear attacks, Japan has a deep cultural relationship with this word and its abbreviation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原子爆弾|げんしばくだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投下|とうか}→投下：12893_touka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to drop an atomic bomb
- {原子爆弾|げんしばくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧: atomic bomb development
- {原子爆弾|げんしばくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧: atomic bomb victims

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{原爆|げんばく}→原爆：11942_genbaku⟧: atomic bomb (abbreviation) — the more commonly used short form
- {被爆者|ひばくしゃ}: atomic bomb survivor — a word with deep significance in Japanese society
- ⟦{核兵器|かくへいき}→核兵器：13126_kakuheiki⟧: nuclear weapons — the broader category that includes both atomic and hydrogen bombs
- {水素爆弾|すいそばくだん}: hydrogen bomb — a more powerful type of nuclear weapon
